name: Remove Background
description: Removes the background using Apple Vision AI, keeping only the main subject with transparency; output lands next to the original.
requirements: macOS 14+, Xcode CLI Tools, compiled via build.sh

name: Remove Nano Banana Watermark
description: Removes the sparkle watermark from Nano Banana AI-generated images using distance-weighted interpolation with texture matching.

name: Optimize Image
description: Reduces file size by re-encoding (JPG quality 82, PNG via pngquant); shows before/after size in a notification.

name: Resize to w1024px
description: Resizes images to 1024px width while maintaining aspect ratio; skips smaller images. Original is never modified.

name: Strip EXIF
description: Removes metadata (GPS location, camera info) from images for privacy.

name: Add Rounded Corners
description: Adds rounded corners with transparency; great for screenshots in presentations.

name: Add Drop Shadow
description: Adds a soft drop shadow around images; ideal for blog posts and documentation.

name: QR Code
description: Generates a QR code PNG from the file contents (if text) or the file path. Alternate QR action: hexdrx/awesome-quick-actions QR (also decodes QR images).
requirements: Xcode CLI Tools, compiled via build.sh

name: JSON Prettify
description: Formats selected JSON text with proper indentation; result is copied to the clipboard.

name: Convert Case
description: Auto-detects and converts between camelCase, snake_case, and kebab-case; result is copied to the clipboard.

name: WhatsApp Line Wrap
description: Wraps text to 40-character lines for WhatsApp readability; converts ASCII tables to card format.

name: Remove Vowels
description: Removes all vowels, including German umlauts (ae oe ue), from selected text.

name: Text Statistics
description: Shows word, character, and line count of selected text as a macOS notification.

name: Copy File Path
description: Copies the full path of selected file(s) to the clipboard. Alternates: nikolarhristov/quickaction Copy Path, Copy Path (Quoted), Copy Path (URL).

name: Copy Metadata
description: Copies file metadata (type, size, dates, image dimensions) to the clipboard.

name: Copy Folder Tree
description: Copies the folder structure as a text tree to the clipboard.

name: New Textfile
description: Creates Untitled.txt in the current folder and opens it in the default editor. Alternates: smarcsoft/utils New File, yeutterg New File, princelundgren Create text file.

name: Cleanup Caches
description: Frees disk space with a confirmation dialog: clears macOS/npm/Gradle caches, user logs, PM2 logs, runs brew cleanup and npm cache clean; shows freed bytes as a notification.

name: Sleep Check
description: Diagnoses why the Mac won't sleep: lists active power assertions and finds orphaned automation browsers holding a Capturing assertion, offering to kill them via a confirmation dialog.

name: LoC
description: Counts source-code lines in the selected folder(s), skipping .git, node_modules, venvs, build output, and minified files; shows totals in a self-dismissing window.

name: LoC Chart
description: Same counting engine as LoC, but the result appears as a floating HUD panel with an animated per-language bar chart; falls back to a dialog without the compiled panel.
requirements: none (optional: Xcode CLI Tools for the chart panel)

name: Rename Tracks
description: Normalises music filenames in a folder to Artist - Title.ext: title case, strips download clutter (e.g. (Official Video), YouTube IDs), normalises feat.; shows a preview dialog and writes an undo log.

name: Convert
description: Right-click any image/audio/video, pick a target format from a native dropdown; converted file lands next to the original with batch handling, a progress bar, and collision-safe names.
requirements: ffmpeg (Homebrew) for audio/video; images use built-in sips

name: ZIP
description: Zips file(s)/folder(s) with zip -r; prompts for one archive name on multi-select; strips __MACOSX and .DS_Store, never overwrites.

name: File Tools
description: One menu for any file/folder: copy path (POSIX / file:// / name), checksum (SHA-256/1, MD5, verify), new file here, batch rename; collision-safe.

name: QR
description: Decodes QR codes from images (text to clipboard, URLs open in browser); encodes text-file contents or typed text into a QR image; also ships a QR-from-selected-text Services action.

name: Transcribe
description: Transcribes audio/video to a .txt next to the original: English via Apple's on-device recognizer (Russian or English picker), Russian via GigaAM v3 with punctuation.

name: Brotli File
description: Creates a .br compressed copy of a selected file.

name: Gzip File
description: Creates a .gz compressed copy of a selected file.

name: Convert to JPEG
description: Creates a copy of an image file in JPEG format. Alternate: yeutterg/automator-workflows Duplicate as JPG.

name: Resize Images
description: Creates copies of selected image files resized to a chosen width. Alternates: sparanoid/automator-workflows Resize Images, yeutterg/automator-workflows Resize.

name: Translate to English
description: Translates selected text to English, showing a popup of the Google Translate result.

name: Open with VSCodium
description: Opens the selected folder in a new VSCodium window.
requirements: VSCodium with the codium CLI shim in PATH

name: Share with LocalSend
description: Opens the selected file/folder with LocalSend, ready to send.

name: Combine PDF 4-in-1 (Portrait)
description: Combines PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files into a portrait A4 PDF with up to 4 original pages/slides per page (2x2 layout).
requirements: Python 3, PyMuPDF (Word/PowerPoint need Microsoft Office or Pages)

name: Combine PDF 4-in-1 (Landscape)
description: Same 2x2 combining as the portrait workflow, but with a landscape A4 output PDF for wide slides and landscape documents.
requirements: Python 3, PyMuPDF (Word/PowerPoint need Microsoft Office or Pages)

name: Flip Images Horizontally
description: Mirrors selected images left-to-right. Note: modifies files in place; duplicate first if unsure.

name: Rotate Images
description: Rotates selected images 90 degrees left, 90 degrees right, or 180 degrees. Note: modifies files in place. Alternates: yeutterg Rotate Clockwise / Rotate Counterclockwise.

name: Scale Images to 1280px
description: Resizes selected images to 1280px wide. Note: modifies files in place.

name: Normalise JPG Extension Names
description: Renames .JPEG/.jpeg/.JPG extensions to lowercase .jpg for filename consistency.

name: Number Images Sequentially
description: Renames selected images to IMG_0001 format for consistent sequencing.

name: Number Pages Sequentially
description: Renames selected images to PAGE_0000 format (starting at 0), for feeding into PDF creation.

name: Reverse Image File Names
description: Reverses the numbering of an image sequence.

name: New PDF from Images
description: Creates a single PDF from selected images; originals are untouched.

name: Split PDF
description: Splits a multi-page PDF into one file per page. Alternate: yeutterg/automator-workflows Split PDF.

name: Copy Path (Quoted)
description: Copies printf %q-quoted, shell-safe absolute paths of selected items (multiple items joined by newlines) to the clipboard.

name: Copy Path (URL)
description: Copies file:// URL, percent-encoded paths of selected items (multiple items joined by newlines) to the clipboard.

name: Open in VS Code
description: Adds a Finder contextual menu item to open the selected file or folder in Visual Studio Code. Alternate: princelundgren/automator-collection Open in Visual Studio Code.
requirements: Visual Studio Code with the code CLI in PATH

name: ZFS Previous Versions
description: Browse and safely restore previous file versions from TrueNAS/ZFS snapshots; a macOS alternative to the Windows Previous Versions feature for SMB shadow copies.
requirements: none (file must live on a ZFS/TrueNAS snapshot share)

name: OCR Screenshots to Note
description: OCRs one or more screenshots and creates an Apple Note with the combined text; the OCR helper compiles itself automatically on first run.

name: Compress With Password
description: Creates a password-protected ZIP file from the Finder selection via the Quick Actions menu.

name: Duplicate as PNG
description: Makes a copy of image(s) converted to PNG in the same folder. JPG counterpart: cheeaun Convert to JPEG.

name: Split PDF into Images
description: Saves every page of a PDF as an image, with colorspace, file type, resolution, and compression options chosen in a dialog.

name: Combine PDFs
description: Combines multiple selected PDFs into one file with a chosen name. Alternate: princelundgren/automator-collection Merge PDF Pages.

name: Extract PDF Text
description: Extracts selectable text from PDF(s) and saves it to a same-named text file. Alternate: lawrenceting/Automator-Services-and-Workflows Extract PDF Text.

name: Add YYYY-MM-DD Prefix
description: Adds today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format as a prefix to selected filename(s) or folder name(s).

name: Count Words
description: Counts the number of highlighted words and shows the count in a dialog.

name: Get Definition
description: Opens Dictionary.app with the highlighted text as the query, showing the full Dictionary entry.

name: Create App Iconset
description: Generates the full set of macOS app-icon sizes (1024x1024 down to 16x16) from a selected 1024x1024 icon with an sRGB color profile.

name: Create .icns
description: Creates a .icns file from a selected image using iconutil.

name: Unpack .icns
description: Unpacks a .icns file into an .iconset folder using iconutil.

name: Create favicon.ico
description: Creates a favicon.ico (64x64 4x resource) from a selected PNG using ImageMagick.

name: Create favicon.ico (multi-resource)
description: Creates a multi-resource favicon.ico (64x64, 32x32, and 16x16) from a selected PNG using ImageMagick.

name: Add @2x/@3x Suffix
description: Adds @2x (or @3x, via the companion workflow) suffix to retina image asset filenames.

name: Create @2x/@3x Image
description: Auto-downscales retina-size images (e.g. exported from PNG Express) to create @2x (or @3x) versions.

name: Remove @2x/@3x Suffix
description: Removes @2x (or @3x, via the companion workflow) suffix from retina image asset filenames.

name: Convert Image Format
description: Converts selected images to a specific format.

name: Convert WebP to PNG
description: Converts selected WebP images to PNG.

name: Resize Image for WordPress
description: Resizes images to WordPress-friendly dimensions.

name: Compress Images
description: Compresses PNG, JPG, and SVG using OptiPNG, pngcrush, jpegoptim, and svgo; auto-detects the file type of each selected image.
requirements: Homebrew: jpegoptim, svgo (OptiPNG and pngcrush bundled)

name: Create DMG Image
description: Creates a distributable cross-platform hybrid DMG image from a selected directory using hdiutil; prompts for the volume name.

name: Encode Selected Files Using Base64
description: Base64-encodes selected files for use in data URI schemes.

name: Convert Selected Text to Audio File
description: Converts selected text to an AIFF audio file in any application.

name: Convert .ass to .srt
description: Converts .ass subtitle files to .srt subtitle files.

name: Open with rmate
description: Opens the selected file with rmate (TextMate's remote editor helper).

name: Rename Selected Files
description: Renames selected files via the standard Finder rename dialog.

name: Compress PDF Size
description: Compresses images inside PDFs at Smaller/Medium/Larger quality tiers (three workflows): Larger nearly halves file size at near-original quality; Smallest can shrink a 90MB PDF to ~200KB.

name: Convert Video to 1080p
description: Converts a video to a small 1080p file compatible with Google Cardboard players, VLC on Mac/Android, and most devices.

name: Crop Image to 1080p
description: Crops any image to a forced 1920x1080 resolution; great for wallpapers.

name: Crop Image to 720p
description: Crops any image to a forced 1280x720 resolution; great for wallpapers.

name: Add to Alfred Blocklist
description: Adds the selected file to the Alfred blocklist directly from Finder.

name: Remove from Alfred Blocklist
description: Removes the selected file from the Alfred blocklist directly from Finder.

name: ImageOptim (Finder Service)
description: Right-click any image (or a whole folder of them) to lossy/lossless-compress it in place, with no app window; installs itself as a Finder service.
